Version 1.4.0
Date: 2026-09-08

Release Notes:
- Mode B: Balance Both Sides:
  * Added dedicated Mode B interaction allowing students to rearrange equations by forging opposite operations and applying them to both sides.
  * Header mode toggle: Smoothly switch between "Mode A: Move Across" and "Mode B: Balance Both Sides" at any time; resets equation state while preserving player level progression.
  * Equation Layout & Spacing: Generous spacing between operations and symbols for laser targeting.
  * Target Eligibility & "Not Yet" Feedback: Only cleanly cancellable operations are active (e.g. -1 before *3 in 3*Y - 1 = 12). Selecting an ineligible coefficient triggers a gentle "NOT YET" wobble on the coefficient and pulses the active constant.
  * Step 1 - Operation Selection: Point-and-hold picks up active term into a floating laser bubble while keeping the original equation term visible.
  * Step 2 - Forge the Opposite: Dedicated left-hand panel appears displaying four large sign targets (+, −, ×, ÷). 1-second dwell hold on sign. Incorrect signs trigger a non-destructive "nah-uh!" wobble allowing immediate retry; correct sign transforms the bubble with a dual-ring pulse.
  * Step 3 - Apply to Both Sides: Prompt changes to "APPLY TO BOTH SIDES". Moving bubble to the '=' sign triggers equals activation and smoothly splits into two synchronized clones landing on LHS and RHS.
  * Step 4 - Inverse Cancellation & Arithmetic: Variable side automatically cancels inverse operations (e.g. -1 + 1 cancels, leaving 3*Y). Right-hand arithmetic panel prompts the student to resolve the RHS balance (e.g. 12 + 1 = 13).
  * State Resilience: Hand tracking loss preserves current equation and forging state; carried bubble remains securely tethered.
- Files Edited / Created:
  * src/math/types.ts: Added SolverMode, GamePhase, ForgedOperation, BalancedDisplay types.
  * src/math/linearEquation.ts: Implemented Mode B lifecycle (forging, opposite validation, balanced application, cancellation).
  * src/math/linearEquation.test.ts: Vitest suite covering Mode B math logic and phase progression.
  * src/audio/soundEffects.ts: Added forge success, forge incorrect ("nah-uh"), split whoosh, and "not-yet" audio cues.
  * src/ui/forgePanelView.ts: [NEW] Left-hand 4-operator forge panel with 1s dwell SVG progress and shake animations.
  * src/ui/equationView.ts: Added Mode B spacing, target eligibility highlighting, 'NOT YET' feedback, and '=' targeting.
  * src/ui/hudView.ts: Added Mode A / Mode B header toggle switch and v1.4.0 footer badge.
  * index.html: Added forge panel aside and split clone bubble overlay elements.
  * src/styles/index.css: Mode B rail spacing, forge panel styling, dwell SVG circles, split animations, and keyframes.
  * src/game/gameController.ts: Integrated Mode B state transitions and pedagogical hints.
  * src/game/interactionController.ts: Pointer/laser dwell tracking for 1000ms forge targets and '=' split detection.
  * src/main.ts: Orchestrated Mode B UI layout, split animations, sound integration, and local storage persistence.

Version 1.3.0
Date: 2026-09-08

Release Notes:
- Big-Screen Camera View Expansion (2x Size):
  * Drastically enlarged camera viewport on desktop and ultrawide/high-res displays from 400px height (533px width) up to 780px-800px height (1040px-1066px width).
  * Roughly doubles linear dimensions and quadruples usable tracking area for finger lasers and hand gestures.
  * Preserves unclipped 4:3 aspect ratio and object-fit: contain so hands and finger tips are always 100% visible.
- Instant Viewport Size Toggle:
  * Added a sleek "2x View" / "1x View" toggle button in the camera box header.
  * Allows switching instantly between 2x Large and 1x Compact modes on demand.
  * Remembers camera size preference across sessions in localStorage.
- Dynamic Responsive Clearance:
  * Uses adaptive CSS clamp(420px, min(65vh, calc(100vh - 310px)), 780px) and max-width: min(92vw, calc(100vw - 580px), 1100px) so the answers column and connector arrow never collide with or overlap the camera frame.
  * Chromebooks (1366x768) and compact screens remain automatically constrained to fit without page scrolling.
- Centered Stage Widening:
  * Expanded workspace-center container max-width to 1440px to give high-resolution monitors ample room.

Version 1.2.0
Date: 2026-09-08

Release Notes:
- Unclipped Camera Viewport: Switched camera view to a true 4:3 container with object-fit contain, eliminating cropping of the video feed so fingers and hand gestures remain completely in view.
- Finger Laser Performance & Accuracy: Integrated adaptive velocity-responsive ray smoothing (high responsiveness during swift aiming, rock-solid stability during dwell) and lengthened skeletal baseline from MCP knuckle through tip to cut angular noise in half.
- Expanded Target Hitboxes: Increased interactive target padding to 22-24px for reliable, effortless distance targeting.
- Responsive Chromebook Layout: Added fluid scaling and responsive CSS rules for 1366x768 and smaller displays to eliminate vertical or horizontal scrolling.
- Pedagogical Operation Colors: Introduced distinct visual duality for opposite operations:
  * Addition (+): Radiant Glowing Ice-White
  * Subtraction (−): Void Obsidian / Dark Black
  * Multiplication (x): Solar Glowing Crimson-Red
  * Division (÷): Cosmic Glowing Royal-Purple
  Carried floating bubbles and rail tiles dynamically transform colors when crossing the equals sign.
- Running Equation History: Displays ongoing algebraic derivation with Star Wars-style receding 3D perspective lines above the active equation.
- Variable Standardization: Standardized all linear equations to use variable 'Y'.
- Multiplication Representation: Displayed multiplication as "a x Y".
- Next Action Button: Large, prominent "Next Puzzle →" button with dwell progress and open-palm advance.
